note_placeholder_blocker: What the agent needs to go on (required)

errors.unanswered: Answer "{question}": pick an option or write one
errors.blocker_text: The agent is blocked: write what it needs, in Other or in the note

delivery.steered: The run that asked got it while it worked.
delivery.resumed: The stage resumed with this answer.
delivery.thread: No run was listening: it stays in the thread and the next run reads it.
delivery.pending: Not delivered yet: it goes to the agent when the run ends or the other blocking questions are answered.
delivery.resume_failed: Saved, but the agent could not be resumed with it. Relaunch the stage and the agent reads it.

secret_warning: What you write here stays visible in the thread. If the agent needs a secret, store it in Credentials instead of pasting it.
